selection.ownership: CallPage (Krakow, Poland), acquired in 2022 by SaaS Labs (United States/India). International callback-widget API at core.callpage.io. Polish origin of a global edition is not EXCLUDE.

research.searchCoverage: Official CallPage REST API at https://core.callpage.io (Authorization raw API token, Accept application/json, hasError envelope), users/widgets/calls GET docs, Krakow/SaaS Labs identity, and dated incident search (CallPage + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. No qualifying current unresolved CallPage platform compromise found after distinguishing unrelated Poland infrastructure incidents. Not a breach-free claim.

Official CallPage REST authenticates with Authorization: <token> (not Bearer) on https://core.callpage.io. GET /api/v1/external is the documented hello probe used by the pinned validator. GET /api/v1/external/users/all, /widgets/all, /widgets/get, and GET /api/v3/external/calls/{call_id} are documented reads. Operator is CallPage, founded in Krakow and acquired by SaaS Labs in 2022; international product, not a mainland-China edition. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found no qualifying current unresolved CallPage compromise.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to documented GET /api/v1/external, matching the pinned validator hello probe rather than a call-history search.
Native category is messaging: CallPage is a website callback/calling API. Source Communication/Productivity are not in the Rust CATEGORIES allowlist.

Official docs and pinned source agree on https://core.callpage.io and raw Authorization (not Bearer). HTTP 200 bodies with hasError true are failures via bodyErrorPaths. The upstream user-agent is not sent.
Returns raw CallPage JSON envelope under data. Optional offset and limit use official query names.
Returns raw CallPage JSON envelope under data. Optional offset and limit use official query names.
Official example curl uses ?id=1 while the documented parameter table and pinned source send widget_id. Native follows the parameter table and pinned source: widget_id.

Official example HTTP line shows /api/v1/external/calls/{id} while the Action URL, curl, and pinned source use /api/v3/external/calls/{call_id}. Native follows the Action URL, curl, and pinned source.
Declarative GET /api/v3/external/calls/history. Array filters use official call_id[] / widget_ids[] query names.
Declarative POST /api/v1/external/managers/create with official JSON body.
Declarative POST /api/v1/external/managers/delete. CallPage deletes via POST, not HTTP DELETE.
Declarative GET /api/v1/external/managers/get with user_id and widget_id.
Declarative GET /api/v1/external/managers/all.
Composio status statistics have no dedicated REST path; this is GET /managers/all for the widget so enabled/disabled counts can be derived from the list payload.
Declarative POST /api/v1/external/managers/update.
Declarative POST /api/v1/external/sms/create. message_id accepts official and Composio event slugs.
Declarative GET /api/v1/external/sms/all.
Declarative POST /api/v1/external/sms/reset. Omitting message_id resets all templates.
Declarative POST /api/v1/external/sms/update. Default templates cannot be updated.
Declarative POST /api/v1/external/users/create. Optional enabled is forwarded because Composio documents it as API-required.
Declarative POST /api/v1/external/users/delete.
Declarative POST /api/v1/external/users/update.
Declarative POST /api/v1/external/voice/create. file is a public audio URL, not multipart bytes.
Declarative GET /api/v1/external/voice/all.
Declarative POST /api/v1/external/voice/reset.
Declarative POST /api/v1/external/widgets/add-users. user_id may be one id or an array.
Declarative POST /api/v1/external/widgets/call-or-schedule (Composio CALLPAGE_POST_WIDGET_CALL_OR_SCHEDULE), not the simple /widgets/call path.
Declarative POST /api/v1/external/widgets/create.
Declarative POST /api/v1/external/widgets/delete.
Declarative POST /api/v1/external/widgets/update. settings is an optional array of widget setting objects.
